M6.falha_pt: Confunde o princípio com o grupo: dá para deixar pessoas hostis sem deixar de poupar os animais

en.frase: Vegans are annoying and bossy; I don't want to be part of that group
formas: I left because of the vegans themselves
The movement is toxic; I got tired of the policing
I don't want to be mistaken for those people
en.falha: Confuses the principle with the group: you can leave hostile people without ceasing to spare animals

M7.falha_pt: Confunde o rótulo com a prática: o nome é opcional, e o que alcança os animais é o que se faz

en.frase: I don't want to be labeled; the label brings pressure
formas: I don't want to be labeled as anything
When I said I was vegan, everyone watched me
I'd rather eat without giving it a name
en.falha: Confuses the label with the practice: the name is optional, and what reaches the animals is what one does

M8.falha_pt: Falsa dicotomia entre pureza total e abandono: o veganismo pede o possível e praticável, e não perfeição

en.frase: It became an obsession; I lived with guilt
formas: I read every label and it was never enough
I got tired of carrying the weight of the world
en.falha: False dichotomy between total purity and giving up: veganism asks for what is possible and practicable, not perfection

M9.falha_pt: Mudar de ideia sobre a saúde não responde à razão pelos animais, que pode ter existido e perdido força, ou nunca ter sido examinada

en.frase: I was vegan for my health, and I changed my mind
formas: I went vegan because of a health documentary and later saw it wasn't quite like that
It was for the environment, but now I buy local meat
It was never about the animals
en.falha: Changing your mind about health does not answer the reason concerning animals, which may have existed and lost strength, or never been examined
